Continent.subject: World Geography
Continent.question: What is Large geographical region identified by convention?
Continent.fact: A continent is any of several large terrestrial geographical regions.   Continents are generally identified by convention rather than any strict criteria.   A continent could be a single large landmass, a landmass and nearby islands either on or beyond its continental shelf, or a part of a larger landmass, as in the case of Asia and Europe within Eurasia.   Due to these varying definitions, the number of continents varies, up to seven or as few as four.
